# list_available_prompts_tool

> List all available LLM prompts that can be used when creating agents.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=list_available_prompts_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List all available LLM prompts that can be used when creating agents. This tool helps discover
existing prompts or understand what information is needed to create a new prompt.

FILTERING CAPABILITIES:
- availability_type: Filter by "agent" (for agent creation) or "chat" (for conversations)
- prompt_type: Filter by "system" (personality/behavior) or "user" (task instructions)

When creating an agent with dual-prompt system:
1. Use availability_type="agent" and prompt_type="system" to find system prompts for agent personality
2. Use availability_type="agent" and prompt_type="user" to find user prompts for task instructions
3. You can also create new prompts directly in the agent configuration

Returns detailed information about each prompt including:
- Prompt name, description, and text
- Prompt type (system/user) and availability type (agent/chat)
- Whether the prompt is active
- Usage statistics (which agents use this prompt)

Example workflow for agent creation:
1. Use list_available_llm_models_tool to see available models
2. Use list_available_prompts_tool with availability_type="agent" and prompt_type="system" for system prompts
3. Use list_available_prompts_tool with availability_type="agent" and prompt_type="user" for user prompts
4. Use create_agent_tool with either existing prompt names or new prompt text

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_inactive` | boolean | no | Include inactive prompts (default: false) |
| `search_term` | string | no | Search for prompts containing this term in name, description, or prompt text. |
| `include_prompt_text` | boolean | no | Include full prompt text in results (default: true) |
| `availability_type` | string | no | Filter by availability type: "agent" or "chat". |
| `prompt_type` | string | no | Filter by prompt type: "system" or "user". |
